name: Lazarus
source:
Lazarus is the leader and co-founder of the anti-monster terrorist organization Ilias Kreuz. Despite his calm and charismatic nature, many people who have interacted with Lazarus (Luka included) consider him to be insane.

[From [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Lazarus]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
